record.body: Durable learning: once causal manufacturing Y/M and consumer independence are separately observable, the next production-function primitive is not another sensor family but a selector that composes both into a deterministic consumer-manufacturing portfolio. Raw repository count is not fanout capital; evidence-root orthogonality, exact-subject qualification, replay/falsifiers, cost, reversibility and downstream causal value must jointly determine the next consumer. Concurrent default movement is topology, not failure: freeze construction base for provenance, require exact-head candidate courts, preserve concurrent non-conflicting main capital, and merge only after mergeability plus independent exact-head qualification. Project transport races must fail with typed 409 and be retried from a freshly resolved head; never force over a receipt commit.
record.title: R71 orthogonal consumer capital learning
